channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — November 12, 2026
item.description:
Today's 50 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x (562,033 ⭐) — Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
  2. public-apis/public-apis (498,424 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  3. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (459,034 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  4. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (401,482 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  5. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (371,895 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  6. jwasham/coding-interview-university (364,301 ⭐) — A complete computer science study plan to become a software engineer.
  7. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (336,337 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  8. vinta/awesome-python (334,226 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  9. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (289,598 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  10. torvalds/linux (255,472 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
